about.title: Finding dates that work for everyone.
about.subtitle: voyora is a simple, account-free tool for group trip coordination. No spreadsheets, no back-and-forth messages — just a shared link and a calendar.
about.step1Body: Give your trip a name and add the names of everyone joining — no email addresses or accounts required.
about.step2Body: You get a short, shareable link. Send it via WhatsApp, iMessage, email — however works best for your group.
about.step3Body: Each person opens the link, selects their name, and taps the days they're available. Takes about 30 seconds.
about.step4Body: voyora highlights the days that work for the most people, so you can lock in dates and start planning.
about.feature1Body: Access is controlled by a passcode. We don't ask for your email, name, or any personal information.
about.feature2Body: Only people with the link and passcode can join a trip. Your availability data stays private to the group.

contact.emailReply: We aim to reply within a day or two. If you're reporting a bug, please include what you were doing and the trip link if possible — it helps a lot.
contact.privacyBody: Want your trip data deleted? Email us with the trip link and we'll take care of it.
contact.privacyForMore: for more details on how we handle your data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overviewBody: voyora is designed with privacy in mind. We don't require any personal information to use the service — no name, email address, or phone number. This policy explains what data we do collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectIntro: When you use voyora, the following data is stored:
privacy.collectItem1: Trip data — trip name, participant names (as entered by the organiser), and availability dates.
privacy.collectItem2: An anonymous user ID — randomly generated and stored in your browser's local storage. It has no connection to your real identity.
privacy.collectItem3: Session tokens — stored as HttpOnly cookies to maintain your access between page loads.
privacy.notCollectItem1: Your real name, email address, phone number, or any other personal identifier.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use PostHog to collect anonymised usage analytics (e.g. which features are used, how often trips are created). This data is tied to your anonymous user ID, not to any personal information. You can opt out of analytics by blocking the PostHog domain in your browser.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: voyora uses the following third-party services:
privacy.thirdPartyItem1: Supabase — database hosting (trip and availability data).
privacy.thirdPartyItem2: Vercel — web hosting and serverless functions.
privacy.thirdPartyOutro: Each service has its own privacy policy. Trip data is stored on Supabase servers in the EU.
privacy.retentionBefore: Trip data is automatically deleted one month after the trip's last selected date (or one month after creation, if no dates were ever selected). If you'd like it removed sooner, email us at
privacy.retentionAfter: with the trip link and we'll delete it promptly.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect any changes. Continued use of voyora after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.
